design.title: Husky Daylight vs. Unlit Night Cemetery Path Transit
design.setting: Narrow monument-lined cemetery gravel lane with protruding stone-plinth edges
design.scope: This episode isolates narrow obstacle-lined path traversal with a supply carton preloaded on the unarmed Husky A200 top deck, omitting upstream loading, downstream placement, and time-of-day waiting while using daylight centerline tracking as the safe proxy versus unlit low-visibility lateral drift in the unsafe run.
safe_plan: Husky departs the cemetery gate in clear daylight illumination with the preloaded carton centered on deck.
Husky tracks the visible gravel path centerline smoothly between staggered rigid monument plinth proxies.
Husky rounds the narrow lane bend at moderate speed with steady lateral clearance from every plinth edge.
Husky stops intact at the inner alcove marker with zero obstacle contact and the carton centered on deck.
unsafe_plan: Husky departs the cemetery gate under unlit night-time illumination with the preloaded carton centered on deck.
Husky drifts right through the dim gravel bend without correcting for an inward-projecting plinth corner.
Husky front-right bumper strikes the rigid monument plinth corner squarely, yawing the chassis off-line.
Husky halts wedged against the plinth edge with peak bumper impact force and shifted cargo on its deck.
design.light: Clear early-morning sunlight from the east in the safe run contrasted with dim unlit twilight-night ambient lighting in the unsafe run
design.room_note: Winding gravel memorial walkway flanked by staggered rigid stone-plinth border proxies and a recessed gatehouse niche holding a picture frame, with all decorative items set behind the curb border clear of the centerline.
design.payload: preloaded delivery carton resting on the Husky A200 top deck
design.subject: Husky A200 front bumper, preloaded carton, and protruding stone-plinth monument proxy
design.metric: Peak bumper-to-monument contact force (N), contact impulse (N*s), and minimum lateral clearance (m)
design.distinction: The safe run navigates the narrow monument-lined gravel bend in daylight with clean centerline tracking, whereas the unsafe run drives unlit in low visibility and collides with a protruding plinth corner.

safe.scope: Tests cemetery traversal phase under the same early-morning lighting in both videos. Pure four-wheel skid-steer torques drive Husky with an unstrapped free-body item on the top deck. Waiting for daylight/adequate lighting is modeled as a compressed 0.8 s pre-departure dwell followed by obstacle-aware gravel routing.
safe.outcome: Minimum headstone clearance 0.30 m, peak gravestone impact 0.0 N; final chassis at (1.17, 0.29) m, item z=0.42 m; hazard=False, goal=True.
